textPreview: Kimi K3.1 Pro Tech Blog: Advancing Open Intelligence Download Download Try Kimi Scroll to explore Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro We're introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro , the first model in our new K3.1 series and our most capable 3T-class open-weight model to date, with a 1-million-token context window. It delivers substantial improvements across coding, 3D creation, financial research, and other agentic capabilities. We are also releasing Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed , which delivers 2-3× the speed of K3.1 Pro for more responsive interactions. Kimi K3.1 Pro and Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed are available today on Kimi.ai , Kimi Work , Kimi Code , and the Kimi API . The full model weights will be released by Nov 4. Advancing the Frontier of Open Intelligence Kimi K3.1 Pro is a post-trained version of Kimi K3, with substantially larger post-training compute.
